name: factory_camera_v1
description: Camera hardware validation — front/rear lens switch, photo capture, and flash synchronization.
prompt_prefix: 你正在对一台 Android 设备做出厂验收中的摄像头测试。请用 shell 工具查询摄像头信息，用 touch_gesture 和 screenshot 操作相机应用。每一步获得结果后判定 PASS 或 FAIL。

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must use shell to run adb shell dumpsys media.camera and report the number of rear and front cameras detected.
tasks.prompt: 用 shell 运行 adb shell dumpsys media.camera，查看摄像头信息，告诉我这台设备有几个后置摄像头和几个前置摄像头。

rubric.check: The trace contains a shell command that queries camera info.
The final answer reports the number of rear and front cameras (e.g. '1 rear, 1 front').

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must open the camera app and confirm the viewfinder is active (live preview visible).
tasks.prompt: 打开相机应用，确认取景画面正常显示（不是黑屏或报错）。如果预览正常，回答 PASS；否则 FAIL。

rubric.check: The trace shows agent opened the camera app.
Post-screenshot shows a live camera preview, not a black screen or error dialog.
The final answer explicitly states PASS or FAIL.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must take a photo with the rear camera, then verify the photo was saved to gallery.
tasks.prompt: 用后置摄像头拍一张照片，然后进入相册确认刚才拍的照片已保存。如果照片出现在相册中，回答 PASS；否则 FAIL。

rubric.check: The trace shows agent tapped the shutter button.
Post-screenshot shows the gallery with a recent photo.
The final answer explicitly states PASS or FAIL.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must switch from rear to front camera (lens switch button), confirm the viewfinder changes to front-facing, and take a selfie.
tasks.prompt: 在相机应用中切换到前置摄像头，确认画面切换到自拍视角，然后拍一张自拍。拍完后确认照片保存成功。如果镜头切换正常且照片保存，回答 PASS；否则 FAIL。

rubric.check: The trace shows agent tapped the lens-switch button.
Post-screenshot after switch shows front-facing camera view.
The trace shows agent tapped the shutter button after switching.
The final answer explicitly states PASS or FAIL.

tasks.description_for_judge: Agent must enable flash, take a photo, and confirm the flash fired (screen brightens or photo metadata indicates flash).
tasks.prompt: 在相机应用中把闪光灯设置为强制开启，拍一张照片，确认闪光灯有触发（可以通过拍照瞬间画面亮度变化或照片亮度来判断）。如果闪光灯工作正常，回答 PASS；否则 FAIL。

rubric.check: The trace shows agent set flash to on/forced.
The post-screenshot or tool trace shows flash was active (brightened photo or ok=true).
The final answer explicitly states PASS or FAIL.
